en: Hand‑tinted early 20th‑century studio photograph showing four uniformed soldiers in green tunics and caps relaxing playfully while a woman in a striped yellow dress with a white apron offers them food from a wicker basket. The scene is staged against a painted backdrop of a European cityscape with a river and a prominent hilltop cathedral or castle in the distance, while birch‑branch fencing and artificial greenery frame the foreground. A green‑and‑white flag lies on the ground beside their rifles.
